package: Act I focused optimizer and distance-barrier refinements

scenes.name: A1_random_independent_attempts
scenes.educational_message: Random Search samples a new complete open-loop genome for every candidate; best-so-far is reporting only.

scenes.name: A2_local_incumbent_neighbors
scenes.educational_message: Local Search evaluates complete mutated neighbor genomes, then accepts an improvement between episodes.

scenes.name: A3_ga_population_variation
scenes.educational_message: GA generates candidates through population selection, crossover, mutation, and elitism.

scenes.name: A4_matched_method_comparison
scenes.educational_message: The same seed, physics, fitness, and evaluation budget expose different candidate-generation semantics, not a general ranking.

scenes.name: B1_rectangular_spiral_barrier
scenes.educational_message: A boundary-attached separator forces every feasible path through a region farther from the goal than the start.

scenes.name: B2_rectangular_spiral_optimizer
scenes.educational_message: One recorded GA run under closest-approach Euclidean fitness approaches the wall but does not establish optimizer impossibility.
